text: The app is not bad but if you add some instructions what's the app can give me ? and the background color is not very comfortable for the eyes
author: Asdaq Derty
developer_reply: Hi! 👋 About instructions, please read the 'How does it work?' section in our page on Google Play. If you have any questions after that, send them to kitekiapp@gmail.com 😀 About the color, you may find it useful to change the interface to the dark theme (Settings / Interface / Theme). In any case, which color would you prefer for the background?
